dancers.name: Jenna Dewan
dancers.knownFor: The Rookie • Step Up • actor and dancer
dancers.danceBackground: Elite — former professional backup dancer for Janet Jackson, Missy Elliott and others
dancers.bio: Actor, host and former professional dancer best known for Step Up and The Rookie. She began her entertainment career dancing behind major touring artists, making her the clearest technical front-runner in the cast. Three-time champion Val Chmerkovskiy adds proven choreography and finals experience.

dancers.name: Harry Shum Jr.
dancers.danceBackground: Elite — professional dancer, choreographer and former backup dancer
dancers.bio: Actor and dancer known for Glee, the Step Up films, Shadowhunters and Grey's Anatomy. Before acting took off, he toured and performed with artists including Beyoncé, Jennifer Lopez and Mariah Carey and also worked as a choreographer and instructor. He is paired with two-time champion Jenna Johnson.

dancers.name: Amber Glenn
dancers.danceBackground: Strong crossover — elite musicality, edges, spins, lines and performance from figure skating
dancers.bio: American figure skater and 2026 Olympic team-event gold medalist. Skaters historically translate exceptionally well to the ballroom because they already understand choreography, musical phrasing, extension and live performance pressure. Pasha Pashkov is her professional partner.

dancers.name: Julia Stiles
dancers.knownFor: 10 Things I Hate About You • Save the Last Dance
dancers.danceBackground: Moderate — intensive ballet and hip-hop preparation for Save the Last Dance
dancers.bio: Actor and director whose credits include 10 Things I Hate About You, Save the Last Dance and the Bourne films. She was not a lifelong competitive dancer, but completed roughly two months of intensive ballet and hip-hop preparation for Save the Last Dance and performed substantial choreography on screen. Her pro is Ezra Sosa.

dancers.name: Ciara Miller
dancers.knownFor: Summer House • model • former travel nurse
dancers.danceBackground: Strong foundation — about 10 years of ballet growing up
dancers.bio: Bravo reality personality, model and former travel nurse best known for Summer House. Her long childhood ballet background suggests useful posture, lines, flexibility and body awareness even after time away from formal training. She will dance with Brandon Armstrong.

dancers.name: Maura Higgins
dancers.knownFor: Love Island UK • The Traitors • TV presenter
dancers.danceBackground: Moderate — childhood Irish dancing plus Dancing on Ice choreography
dancers.bio: Irish television personality who broke out on Love Island UK and later competed on The Traitors. Childhood Irish dance and her Dancing on Ice run give her experience learning routines and selling a performance. Three-time Mirrorball winner Mark Ballas makes this an especially intriguing pairing.

dancers.name: Tyler Cameron
dancers.danceBackground: Some crossover — competed on The Real Dirty Dancing; former college football player
dancers.bio: Model, contractor and television personality who finished as runner-up on The Bachelorette. He has athletic size and coordination from college football, plus prior partner-dance exposure from The Real Dirty Dancing. Returning champion Sharna Burgess is back as his pro after five seasons away.

dancers.name: Ezra Frech
dancers.danceBackground: No formal training established — elite explosiveness, balance and body control
dancers.bio: Two-time Paralympian and two-time Paris 2024 gold medalist in track and field, as well as a disability advocate and motivational speaker. Ballroom will be new territory, but his athleticism, adaptability and competitive confidence give Daniella Karagach excellent raw material.

dancers.name: Tatyana Ali
dancers.knownFor: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air • actor and singer
dancers.danceBackground: Performance background — Broadway-trained actor and recording artist; no ballroom record
dancers.bio: Actor, singer, producer and Harvard graduate best known as Ashley Banks on The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air, with more recent appearances on Abbott Elementary. Musical and stage experience should help her timing and presentation, although no substantial competitive dance background is established. Her pro is Jan Ravnik.

dancers.name: Taylor Hanson
dancers.danceBackground: Performance crossover — lifelong musician with strong rhythm; no formal training established
dancers.bio: Singer, songwriter and multi-instrumentalist from the pop-rock band Hanson, famous for the global hit MMMBop. Decades of live performance should provide musical timing, stamina and crowd connection, though ballroom technique will be new. He is partnered with Britt Stewart.

dancers.name: Jackson Olson
dancers.knownFor: Savannah Bananas • Banana Ball • social media
dancers.danceBackground: Athletic showman — frequent choreographed routines with the Savannah Bananas
dancers.bio: Savannah Bananas baseball player and social-media personality whose job blends athleticism, comedy and crowd entertainment. He lacks traditional ballroom training but regularly learns choreography and performs under pressure. Mirrorball champion Emma Slater is his professional partner.

dancers.name: Sarah Jane Nader
dancers.danceBackground: No formal dance background publicly established
dancers.bio: Model and reality personality from Love Thy Nader, and sister of season 33 contestant Brooks Nader. Modeling brings poise, lines and camera awareness, but she enters as a technical unknown. She is paired with newly promoted pro Hailey Bills.

dancers.name: Connor Wood
dancers.knownFor: Comedian • TikTok • Brooke and Connor podcast
dancers.danceBackground: No formal training established — stage comfort and comic performance
dancers.bio: Stand-up comedian, social creator and co-host of Brooke and Connor Make a Podcast. His biggest early assets are likability, timing and comfort performing for an audience; the technical side is a blank slate. He will dance with Rylee Arnold.

dancers.name: Conner Leavitt
dancers.knownFor: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives
dancers.danceBackground: No formal training established — close exposure through wife Whitney Leavitt's DWTS run
dancers.bio: Reality personality known from The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives and husband of season 34 contestant Whitney Leavitt. He has seen the DWTS process up close but enters without a documented dance résumé. His partner is Adele Zaikman, the winner of Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro.

dancers.name: Giada De Laurentiis
dancers.danceBackground: No formal dance background publicly established
dancers.bio: Emmy-winning chef, author and television host who became a Food Network fixture through Everyday Italian and Giada at Home. She is an experienced live presenter but arrives as one of the season's bigger dance unknowns. Mirrorball champion Alan Bersten will guide her.

dancers.name: Guillermo Rodriguez
dancers.danceBackground: No formal dance background publicly established
dancers.bio: Longtime Jimmy Kimmel Live! personality who went from studio security guard to one of late-night television's most recognizable comedy sidekicks. He brings enormous likability and performance comfort but no notable formal dance training. His pro is reigning champion Witney Carson.

notes: Auction draft: Sept. 8 at 7 PM, one week before the Sept. 15 premiere.
Full 16-couple cast and official professional pairings added Sept. 2.
